entities.summary: Lenny Castro is an American percussionist. He is one of the most prolific percussionists of all time, appearing on hundreds of albums, including those by the Red Hot Chili Peppers, Adele, Maroon 5, U2, Earth, Wind & Fire, Toto, and the Rolling Stones, among others.
